summary.text: Tim Ackert represents Connecticut's 8th House District, which encompasses Bolton, Columbia, Coventry, Lebanon and part of Tolland; the page says he was re-elected to a seventh term in November 2022.

paragraphs.text: He serves on the Labor and Public Employees, Energy and Technology, and General Law committees and is a Deputy Leader At-Large of the House Republican Caucus.
He is a small business owner and an Air Force veteran, and has served on the Board of Trustees for Connecticut Community Colleges and as President of the Connecticut Jaycees.
